elements.name: useExistingScriptStorage
elements.label: Use an existing storage account for deployment scripts
elements.toolTip: The CrowdStrike deployment scripts run in an Azure Container Instance and normally create their own storage account with public network access. Use this if a policy blocks that account.

options.text: Use a storage account in the infrastructure subscription with shared key access enabled and no firewall rules. If public network access is disabled on it, also enter a subnet in the deployment region delegated to Microsoft.ContainerInstance/containerGroups, so the script runs in that virtual network. That subnet needs a NAT gateway for outbound traffic. With public network access disabled, the storage account also needs a private endpoint for file in that virtual network and the privatelink.file.core.windows.net DNS zone linked to it (requirements the form can't check).

elements.name: storageAccount
elements.label: Storage account
elements.toolTip: Existing storage account in the infrastructure subscription.

elements.name: subnetId
elements.label: Subnet resource ID (optional)
elements.toolTip: Optional unless public network access is disabled on the storage account. A subnet delegated to Microsoft.ContainerInstance/containerGroups. With a subnet, the script mounts the storage with its managed identity and no key is passed.

elements.name: storageCheck
elements.label: Selected storage account
elements.toolTip: The storage account the deployment scripts will use. The checks below run against it.

validations.message: Still reading the storage account (or it couldn't be read).
The storage account must be in the infrastructure subscription (deployment scripts only accept a storage account from their own subscription).
The storage account has shared key access disabled. Deployment scripts need allowSharedKeyAccess = true, even with a subnet.
The storage account has firewall rules (default action Deny). CrowdStrike's template doesn't support storage firewalls; use publicNetworkAccess Disabled with a subnet instead.
This storage account's kind and SKU don't support Azure file shares. Use StorageV2 with a Standard SKU, or FileStorage with a Premium SKU.
Public network access is disabled on this storage account, so the script can only reach it from a virtual network. Enter a delegated subnet.
The subnet must be in the infrastructure subscription.
Enter the subnet's full resource ID (…/virtualNetworks/<vnet>/subnets/<subnet>).
Still reading the subnet (or it couldn't be read - check the resource ID and your access).
The subnet isn't delegated to Microsoft.ContainerInstance/containerGroups.
The subnet's virtual network must be in the deployment region (the script's container instance runs there).

options.text: Without a subnet, the deployment looks up this storage account's access key and passes it to the CrowdStrike template. It is then readable in the deployment stack's parameters by anyone who can read the stack. Enter a delegated subnet to avoid passing a key, or rotate the key after deploying.
✅ Storage account meets the deployment script requirements the form can check.
